ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Initialization sequence — CMD0 → CMD8 (v2.0) → ACMD41 loop → CMD2 → CMD3 → CMD9 → CMD7 → ACMD51 → ACMD6 → CMD6 (HS) → CMD11 (UHS-I) → CMD19 (SDR104 tuning) → CMD16 (SDSC only) → ready.
All-state coverage — Inactive, Idle, Ready, Identification, Stand-by, Transfer, Sending-data, Receive-data, Programming, Disconnect.
All-command-class coverage — Class 0 basic, Class 2 read, Class 4 write, Class 5 erase, Class 6 WP, Class 7 lock, Class 8 ACMD, Class 9 SDIO, Class 10 switch, Class 11 function extension.
All-response-class coverage — R1 normal, R1b busy, R2 (CID/CSD), R3 (OCR), R6 (RCA), R7 (interface condition).
Bus modes — SD 1-bit, SD 4-bit, SPI mode.
Voltage modes — 3.3 V HVR; 1.8 V UHS-I after CMD11.
Bus speed modes — Default Speed 25 MHz, High Speed 50 MHz, SDR12, SDR25, SDR50, DDR50, SDR104.
Card capacity types — SDSC (byte address), SDHC (block address), SDXC (block address).
CRC injection — CMD CRC7 fail (host side), DAT CRC16 fail (host write side and card read side).
Error injection in CSR — out-of-range, address error, write protect violation, illegal command, card locked, ECC failure, generic error.
Voltage switch protocol — CMD11 handshake with CMD/DAT LOW + CLK stop + VDDIO transition + release HIGH.
Tuning protocol — CMD19 SEND_TUNING_BLOCK sweep to find optimal sampling phase (mandatory for SDR104).
Multi-block read / write — CMD18/CMD25 with and without CMD23 SET_BLOCK_COUNT; with CMD12 STOP_TRANSMISSION.
Pre-erase optimization — CMD55 + ACMD23 SET_WR_BLK_ERASE_COUNT before CMD25.
Erase operations — CMD32 / CMD33 / CMD38 (Erase / Discard / FULE).
Hot insertion / hot removal — host shall detect, reset, and re-initialize.
Power-up dummy clock — ≥ 74 CLK cycles before CMD0.
Init timeout — ACMD41 shall complete within 1 second.
Lock / unlock — CMD42 password set/clear; forced erase.
Function Extension — CMD48/CMD49/CMD58/CMD59 for power management, performance enhancement.
SPI mode coverage — CS LOW during CMD0; CMD59 CRC on/off; reduced-command subset; Data Response Token + Data Error Token in SPI.
fields.notes: The simplified spec does not include a formal verification plan or testbench; categories above are derived from Sections 4 (Functional Description), 5 (Card Registers), 6 (Hardware Interface) and 7 (SPI Mode). SD Card Association maintains a separate normative Compliance Test Plan (not part of the Simplified Specification).
